stateController.notes: AuthScreen remains the state shell over AuthController.step. Consumer swaps the existing standalone PhoneStep/OtpStep presentations. Host uses the user-selected plain Quiet Stage: the existing larger horizontal mark shares a safe-area reading lane with native launch and Flutter startup, and a top-aligned inset HostAuthCard switches between phone entry and inline OTP. One scroll owner reveals focused controls on short screens or with a keyboard. PhoneStep owns local phone editing, country picker UI, validation, and send feedback; OtpStep owns OTP text, cooldown, verify/resend feedback, and edit-number navigation. AuthPhoneEntryViewState and AuthOtpEntryViewState expose fixtureable phone, masked-number, OTP, cooldown, mutation, resend, verify, and edit-number display policy.

designRefs.notes: Auth screen tests cover Consumer standalone composition, Host shared native/startup/auth logo geometry, inset card placement on phone/tablet, short-screen keyboard and large-text control visibility, inline OTP transition, phone validation, send/verify mutations, resend, and edit-number behavior.
Auth input tests cover phone and OTP validation/normalization logic used by the visible form states.

The historical auth phone-entry and OTP references are exported, masked, and manifest-registered, but they predate the product-approved Host Option 1 direction. Genuine canonical widget captures cover the selected phone/OTP and mutation/accessibility states; registering final source references and physical native-to-Flutter transition acceptance remain outstanding.

composition.currentLayout: AuthScreen watches AuthController.step and projects one of two presentation adapters. Consumer keeps the standalone onboarding pages. HostAuthScaffold owns a startup-identical StartupBrandHeader and one scrollable brand/card column; AnimatedSwitcher replaces the top-aligned inset HostAuthCard content between PhoneStep and inline OtpStep. The step widgets retain text controllers, validation, timers, mutation calls, and branded feedback, while provider-free view states own derived labels, masking, loading, cooldown, and action enablement.
composition.targetLayout: Implemented: keep AuthController as the shared mutation owner, local text/timer lifecycle in the step widgets, and role-specific composition in AuthScreen. Preserve the Host startup/auth logo anchor and one-card inline transition while routing reusable display policy through AuthPhoneEntryViewState and AuthOtpEntryViewState.

sections.migration: HostAuthScaffold now keeps the real Host mark pixel-stable from Flutter startup through phone and OTP states, while only the lower content enters and switches; Consumer retains the standalone adapter. AuthController remains the mutation owner.

sections.name: Auth phone entry section
sections.migration: PhoneStep now derives country and send loading display state through AuthPhoneEntryViewState. Its Host adapter uses one outlined HostAuthCard, unified flag/dial-code/phone field, and rectangular Send code action; validation and mutation error mapping remain local because they depend on Form and BuildContext.

sections.name: Auth OTP entry section
sections.migration: OtpStep now derives masked phone copy, cooldown label, resend label, verify/resend/edit-number enablement, and verify loading through AuthOtpEntryViewState while keeping timer and text-controller lifecycle local. Its Host adapter reveals these states inline in the same card and auto-verifies a complete code.
